0x00221ec4 0x00621ec4 401  402 .data   ascii   SPICA is designed to accurately reflect the dynamics of the chart in a systematic and objective manner. This does not mean that the various scoring systems used on the worksheets are the one and only truth. There are differences of opinion in many areas, and the relative importance of each factor is estimated by the developers of SPICA, in the absence of more detailed information from the classics.
0x00222058 0x00622058 206  207 .data   ascii   To initially simplify Step 1B, you may limit yourself to only look at he influences on the MPL. However, the most accurate results are gained by considering all three Lagnas in proportion to their strength.
0x00222128 0x00622128 400  401 .data   ascii   In step 1B you will determine how many favorable and unfavorable infuences there are on the Lagna, which show how much "strain" there is in the life of the individual. The importance of the favorable and unfavorable influences on the lagna vs those on the Moon or Sun, are directly proportionate to the strength of the Lagna, Moon and Sun. The stronger one is, the more relevant the influences on it.
0x002222bc 0x006222bc 140  141 .data   ascii   Now you know which Lagna(s) is (are) to be used to read the 12 houses from, you are ready for making a higher level evaluation of the chart.
0x0022234c 0x0062234c 359  360 .data   ascii   Notes: The strength of a planet is determined by its Shadbala. To find out whether the Ascendant lord, Moon or Sun is stronger, compare their Shadbala values. If one is significantly stronger than the other, use that as the MPL. If all are close in value (+/- 15%), or if the Lagna is only moderately weaker we will consider all 3 Lagnas as equally important.

0x00224364 0x00624364 185  186 .data   ascii   4. When you are done with Step 5, you get a clear picture of the predominance of favorable or unfavorable influence, and which planetary influences are predominant in that area of life.
0x00224420 0x00624420 674  675 .data   ascii   3.For the same 4 house positions and their lords, look at the chart and identify planets related to these houses and rulers. Check such planets off at the right: planets that are in that house, rule the house, fully aspect the house,are conjunct the house ruler; fully aspect the house ruler; or are dispositor of the house ruler. If a planet fulfills this condition multiple times (i.e. it is the ruler of the house and aspects it too), put the corresponding number. Similarly, look at the house rulers for those 4 house positions, and the Karaka planet itself, and copy their favorable or unfavorable condition as recorded in Step 3. Wehn you are done, a mere glance over the favorable/unfavorable columns will give the overall favorable or unfavorable experience in the area of relationships.

0x00221ec4 0x00621ec4 401  402 .data   ascii   SPICA is designed to accurately reflect the dynamics of the chart in a systematic and objective manner. This does not mean that the various scoring systems used on the worksheets are the one and only truth. There are differences of opinion in many areas, and the relative importance of each factor is estimated by the developers of SPICA, in the absence of more detailed information from the classics.
0x00222058 0x00622058 206  207 .data   ascii   To initially simplify Step 1B, you may limit yourself to only look at he influences on the MPL. However, the most accurate results are gained by considering all three Lagnas in proportion to their strength.
0x00222128 0x00622128 400  401 .data   ascii   In step 1B you will determine how many favorable and unfavorable infuences there are on the Lagna, which show how much "strain" there is in the life of the individual. The importance of the favorable and unfavorable influences on the lagna vs those on the Moon or Sun, are directly proportionate to the strength of the Lagna, Moon and Sun. The stronger one is, the more relevant the influences on it.
0x002222bc 0x006222bc 140  141 .data   ascii   Now you know which Lagna(s) is (are) to be used to read the 12 houses from, you are ready for making a higher level evaluation of the chart.
0x0022234c 0x0062234c 359  360 .data   ascii   Notes: The strength of a planet is determined by its Shadbala. To find out whether the Ascendant lord, Moon or Sun is stronger, compare their Shadbala values. If one is significantly stronger than the other, use that as the MPL. If all are close in value (+/- 15%), or if the Lagna is only moderately weaker we will consider all 3 Lagnas as equally important.

0x00224364 0x00624364 185  186 .data   ascii   4. When you are done with Step 5, you get a clear picture of the predominance of favorable or unfavorable influence, and which planetary influences are predominant in that area of life.
0x00224420 0x00624420 674  675 .data   ascii   3.For the same 4 house positions and their lords, look at the chart and identify planets related to these houses and rulers. Check such planets off at the right: planets that are in that house, rule the house, fully aspect the house,are conjunct the house ruler; fully aspect the house ruler; or are dispositor of the house ruler. If a planet fulfills this condition multiple times (i.e. it is the ruler of the house and aspects it too), put the corresponding number. 0x002246c4 0x006246c4 631  632 .data   ascii   2. For each of the 4 house positions (as counted from the 4 mentioned Lagnas), copy the condition of that position from Step 4. Similarly, look at the house rulers for those 4 house positions, and the Karaka planet itself, and copy their favorable or unfavorable condition as recorded in Step 3. Wehn you are done, a mere glance over the favorable/unfavorable columns will give the overall favorable or unfavorable experience in the area of relationships.
